name: RC-B10-0372/2025 – After § 1 – Am 30
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text: 1d. Recalls that trade with illegal Israeli settlements is actively aiding the dispossession of Palestinians of their land and the maintenance and entrenchment of the apartheid regime in the West Bank; further notes that the profits of trade with illegal settlements are the proceeds of crime and should be treated as such by legal authorities; calls for an EU-wide ban on all trade and business with illegal Israeli settlements in order for the EU and Member States to comply with their international law obligations as clarified by the July 2024 Advisory Opinion of the International Court of Justice;
